# Invyto

> Invyto is an India-based platform for digital wedding invitations shared as one WhatsApp link — with dates, venue map, timings and your story.

Invyto focuses on Kerala and Malayalam weddings first. Couples browse live examples, then create a polished mobile invitation guests open in the browser (no app or login).

## Primary pages

- [Home](https://www.invyto.in/): Digital wedding invitations for WhatsApp
- [Live examples](https://www.invyto.in/#live-examples): Browse live invitation examples
- [Wedding invitations](https://www.invyto.in/wedding-invitations): Hub for language and tradition pages
- [Malayalam wedding invitation](https://www.invyto.in/wedding-invitations/malayalam)
- [Kerala wedding invitation](https://www.invyto.in/wedding-invitations/kerala)

- [Blog](https://www.invyto.in/blog): Guides on WhatsApp e-invites and wording
